title: Grinch Lemon Drop Freezer Door
chill: Freeze for 5–6 hours, or refrigerate until chilled. Freezer consistency may vary.
attribution: Recipe shared on Facebook. Original creator not identified.
description: A bright green, lemony holiday batch with Tito’s vodka, green Kool-Aid and a little edible sparkle. Allow extra time to chill.
ingredients: 59 fl oz Tito’s vodka (one 1.75 L bottle)
12 fl oz freshly squeezed lemon juice
steps: Combine the vodka, lemon juice, simple syrup and half a packet of green Kool-Aid in a large pitcher or mixing container.
Add green edible glitter and stir again to distribute it evenly.
Transfer to a pitcher or divide between freezer-safe containers, leaving space for expansion. The full batch will not fit in the original vodka bottle.
For the freezer-door version, freeze for 5–6 hours; the original recipe describes a slushy texture, though the final consistency depends on your freezer.
If using a pitcher instead, refrigerate until ready to serve.
Stir before serving. Pour individual servings and enjoy responsibly.
note: The liquids total about 77 fl oz (2.28 L). Use a container larger than the original 1.75 L bottle. Preparation time is approximate; chilling time is additional.

title: The Old Fashioned
description: A timeless mix of whiskey, bitters and a little sweetness. Keep it simple; let the spirit shine.
ingredients: Orange peel and a large ice cube
steps: Stir the sugar, bitters and water in a rocks glass until the sugar dissolves.
Add the whiskey and a large ice cube. Stir until chilled.
Twist the orange peel over the glass to release its oils, then add it as a garnish.

title: The Classic Margarita
description: Bright lime, smooth tequila and a salt-kissed rim. A refreshing classic for your recipe collection.
ingredients: Salt, ice and a lime wedge
steps: Run a lime wedge around half the rim of a glass and dip that side in salt. Fill with ice.
Add tequila, lime juice and orange liqueur to a shaker with ice.
Shake until chilled, strain into the prepared glass, and garnish with lime.

title: The Moscow Mule
description: Crisp ginger, a squeeze of lime and vodka over ice. Refreshingly easy to make at home.
steps: Fill a mug or tall glass with ice.
Pour in the vodka and lime juice, then top with ginger beer.
Stir gently and garnish with a lime wedge.
